Do you want to be a part building the next generation of platforms within fintech? Do you have solid experience in backend development and Java, and enjoy taking technical ownership? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence architecture, integrations and scalable solutions in a growing tech company? Then the role as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie could be the right opportunity for you!
About Yabie
Yabie is a Swedish fintech company that has been developing cloud-based POS systems and payment solutions since 2017. By combining payments, point-of-sale systems, sales and other features into a single platform, Yabie helps businesses simplify their daily operations and run their businesses more efficiently. Yabie continues to develop its technology and organisation to create even better and more scalable solutions.
About the role as Senior Software Engineer
As a Senior Software Engineer at Yabie, you will become an important part of the backend team and take clear ownership of developing and maintaining the systems that power Yabie's platform. Part of the role also involves expanding Yabie's API capabilities, including APIs and MCP setup, so that more partners can integrate with their solution. You will work hands-on with Java and Spring Boot, building backend services, APIs and integrations that connect Yabie's platform with partners and external systems. Your work will involve everything from designing new solutions to improving existing integrations, with a strong focus on quality, scalability and maintainability.
The tech team consists of approximately 20 people with expertise in backend development, mobile development, QA and DevOps. You will join the backend team alongside nine other backend developers. You will work closely with both the product teams and other developers, with great opportunities to influence technical solutions and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities:
Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Design and develop integrations between Yabie, partners and external systems.
Contribute to architecture and scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot, optimise and improve existing services.

About you
We are looking for someone with a post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development or a similar field, alternatively equivalent professional experience. You have approximately five or more years of experience in backend development and have worked with Java and Spring Boot in a production environment. You have solid experience in API development, REST, integrations and databases, as well as an understanding of microservices and scalable systems. Experience with AWS is an advantage, as is working with API Gateways such as Kong.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and enjoy taking ownership of the bigger picture. You like understanding how different systems connect and feel comfortable developing technical solutions independently rather than simply implementing predefined specifications. You enjoy collaborating with others and are happy to share your technical knowledge with the team.
Important for the position:
Approximately 5+ years of experience in backend development, including Java, Spring Boot, REST, integrations and API development.
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, as well as AWS.
Understanding of microservices and software architecture.
Extensive experience with AI-assisted development and modern AI tools.
Fluent in English and preferably also Swedish, both spoken and written.

Additional qualifications that are considered a plus:
Experience with Kong.
A background in fintech or payment solutions.
Experience in data engineering or data modelling, and/or experience with Okta or a similar identity platform.

What Yabie offers
At Yabie, you will become part of a tech company where technology has a direct impact on customers' everyday operations. You will work with a platform used by approximately 10,000 businesses and have the opportunity to influence how the platform and its integrations evolve. Yabie actively embraces AI-assisted development and offers you great opportunities to influence both the technology and your own role.
Additional information
Start: By agreement.
Employment: Full-time.
Location: Stockholm.
Salary: By agreement.
Does the position as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie sound interesting to you? Submit your application today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis! We at Needo look forward to hearing from you!
